name: Mini Notes
tagline: A minimal Anna-style notes app with a local summarizer tool.
description: Mini Notes demonstrates a useful Anna App loop: a sandboxed UI bundle saves tagged short notes in browser localStorage, supports search, undo, Markdown import/export, and visible/all summary scope, then calls a local Executa tool through AnnaAppRuntime and anna.tools.invoke to produce a structured rule-based summary with categories, tags, highlights, and action items.
